name: God Trials
description: A series of tasks on Amonkhet that each inhabitant aspired to complete, the core of the plane's faith, perverted by Nicol Bolas into a never-ending cycle.

timeline.summary: Nicol Bolas takes over the God Trials, holding the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.
timeline.quote: Bolas took this tenet and perverted it to hold the population of Naktamun in a never-ending state of exercise.

timeline.summary: With most gods and citizens dead and Naktamun abandoned, the trials can no longer continue.
